title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：sky　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sky 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the farmer ① watched the sky that no child in the field would have counted, and he said the watching was the whole of the autumn. The ② sky, meaning the air itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed uncounted in the book; a sky, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ sky in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ sky at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A sky, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the farmer said the counting is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sky was the whole of the matter, meaning the freedom and not the air. The ⑥ sky, meaning the freedom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; sky, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both an air and a freedom. He said the freedom is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ sky had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ sky of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of counting; sky, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sky I remember is the air counted in the almanac, which closed in 1996 and is still counted as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ sky, my mother said in 1998, is the only air that improves by being counted; every sky, she said, is a freedom that has agreed to look like an air. She said the freedom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 天空（指田垄里每一片旁边的那一片）
B. n. 天空（指那片天空本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch the sky 望这一片天空
D. n. 天空（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 天空之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的天空之事）
F. n. 天空（指农事历里写到、被清点的那一片）
G. n. 天空、开阔（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 开阔（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: watched the sky that no child in the field would have counted
The sky, meaning the air itself and not the basket
the sky at the far fence
the sky was the whole of the matter
the sky had become a line in an almanac
The sky of the whole thing
A sky, my mother said in 1998

answers.why: watch the sky 意为“望这一片天空”，1989 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯清点的一片天空做了一遍。
sky 意为“天空”，指那片天空本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被清点。
sky 意为“天空”，指田垄里每一片旁边的那一片，每一片旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
sky 意为“天空”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sky 意为“天空、开阔”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片开阔就是那件事的全部。
sky 意为“开阔”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片天空，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sky 意为“天空”，指农事历里写到、被清点的那一片，到 1994 年这一片成了农事历里的一行。
sky 意为“天空之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的天空之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的清点。
sky 意为“天空”，我记得的是农事历里清点过的那一片，1996 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一片。
sky 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，天空是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的天空。

task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。

那片天空，指的是那片天空本身而不是小小的竹篮，经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被清点。（sky）
那处田垄里每一片天空旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。（sky）
最远那道篱边那片天空，指的是他们留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（sky）
叔叔说这片开阔就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那片天空。（sky）
